their citations in specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md pointing one
and forty-odd lines early; spec:names --fix repoints them (466→511,
449→494, 478→523, 500→545), which is also what clears the three
require-spec-link errors. The fourth eslint error is the new test's
own: lastMessage.content[0]?.content reaches three hops, so the tool
result is read into a local first, the shape the acceptance suite
already uses.
